title: System Mode
welcome_title: Welcome to ChatWiki. Choose how you want to use it:
description_ai_service: Knowledge-based customer service with lower token usage. A richer knowledge base improves responses. Simple to set up and suitable for beginners.
description_agent: Smarter customer service with better responses and higher token usage. A simple interface that is easy to get started with.
description_advanced: For enterprise knowledge bases and AI workflows. More configuration options and capabilities for experienced users.
